'''Denebia''' was a terrestrial celestial body located in the [[Denebia system/Legends|Denebia system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Situated near the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] area known as [[the Tangles]], it was connected to the [[Anturus system/Legends|Anturus]] and [[Kalgo system/Legends|Kalgo systems]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]], while another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the [[Suliana system/Legends|Suliana system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Denebia's terrain featured [[Temperature/Legends|cool]], [[Water/Legends|dry]] plains. The celestial body's surface was dotted with [[Farm/Legends|plantations]] and [[City/Legends|towns]] of [[House Hax]], one of the region's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]].<ref name="TEA" /> The game known as [[Denebian holo-chess]]<ref name="Riders" /> originated on Denebia.<ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denebia was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
